subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should `sessions.abort.clearQueued` become the permanent public Gateway contract for Control UI cancellation of an exact non-global channel session?
rationale: The patch deliberately adds destructive queue-clearing behavior to a documented Gateway method; compatibility is preserved for existing callers, but whether this public opt-in semantic should exist is a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Approve the explicit queue-cleanup contract
options.body: Keep the optional non-global `clearQueued` field, document its destructive scope, and require exact-head isolation proof before merge.

options.title: Keep session abort non-destructive
options.body: Remove the public queue-cleanup option and limit this PR to aborting the resolved active session run, leaving queued-work policy unchanged.

recommendation.title: Approve the explicit queue-cleanup contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional non-global `clearQueued` field, document its destructive scope, and require exact-head isolation proof before merge.
